paragraphs: Creatio sells a customer relationship management and workflow product it markets as an AI CRM and workflow platform. It is aimed at sales, marketing, and service teams. Buyers build and change enterprise applications with visual designers and natural language instead of code.

The platform is presented as one place to orchestrate both human-led and agentic workflows. Alongside assistants, it offers autonomous agents meant to keep working around the clock. Prebuilt industry workflows are published for twenty verticals. An Unlimited plan covers unlimited users, agents, workflows, applications, and API calls on a single platform.

The company states that it helps thousands of organizations in more than 100 countries run customer workflows. Its customers page lists a senior director for 311 and basic city services technology at the City of Boston. It reported quarterly bookings at 255 percent of the prior year level. It also describes itself as recognized as a Leader and Visionary in Gartner and Forrester reports.

quote.text: Organizations aren't looking to add AI to legacy systems - they're replacing legacy systems with AI-native platforms.
